Shalom World News on Instagram: "On Sunday, September 14, 2025, Pope Leo XIV celebrated his 70th birthday by leading the Angelus with pilgrims gathered in St. Peter’s Square. From dawn, the square brimmed with joyful crowds waving banners, flags, and heartfelt signs, eager to honor the pope’s special day. When musical groups struck up “Happy Birthday,” Leo’s face lit up, and the square erupted in applause, cheers, and a sea of grateful messages. He began his speech by reflecting on the Feast of the Exaltation of the Cross, recalling Saint Helen’s discovery of the Cross in Jerusalem and its return to the Holy City by Emperor Heraclius. As the celebration drew to a close, Leo shared a personal note: “Dear friends, it seems that you know that today I turn seventy years old. I give thanks to the Lord and to my parents, and I thank all those who have remembered me in their prayers. Many thanks to everyone! Thank you! Have a good Sunday!” Later, after the ecumenical celebration for the Commemoration of Martyrs and Witnesses of the Faith in the Twenty-First Century, Cardinals, bishops, and Christian leaders from around the world gathered with the Holy Father for a festive cake cutting. They presented him with a cake, Coke, and a joyful toast.
